ctx.x: ‘50, ‘51 a little part of ‘52 and I went right from the WMGM to the, Show of Shows, and then brought Billy into that later when things got too busy, we had to have a third hand, or a fifth and sixth hand… needless to say. And it was after that that the Elliot Lawrence period started.
So, the three of you; you, Al Cohn and Tiny Kahn did much of the writing at the time.
